name: threat-order
what: One sentence added to step 4 of the weekly and monthly prompts, right after the sentence that says to write the annotations by filling the brief's slots: each board that shows a better move explains it in the order the books' worked examples use (the threat, why the move played or the tempting one fails, what the better move keeps). Nothing else changes.

weekly.text: Each board that shows a better move explains it in its prose in this order: first the threat on the board, the piece and the square it aims at; then why the move played, or the tempting one, fails, with the reply that refutes it; then what the better move keeps, the square, piece or line it holds.

monthly.text: Each board that shows a better move explains it in its prose in this order: first the threat on the board, the piece and the square it aims at; then why the move played, or the tempting one, fails, with the reply that refutes it; then what the better move keeps, the square, piece or line it holds.
